course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A radiology department processes medical images arriving randomly for diagnosis. The arrivals follow a Poisson process with an verage of 30 image scans per 8-hour shift. The service time per scan (i.e., the time to process and analyze an image) is uniformly distributed between $a = 1 0$ and $b = 1 4$ minutes. If the mean and variance for any uniform distribution can be computed using $\frac { b + a } { 2 }$ and $\frac { ( b - a ) ^ { 2 } } { 1 2 }$ respectively, find the followings:
i) The expected fraction of the time, the processing station is idle.
ii) The expected number of scans waiting at any random time during the shift.
iii) The expected time a scan spends in the system.
